title: Create: Transport For Flamingo
description: The UK's biggest Create railway on the internet.
body:
A creative Minecraft network run like the real UK: GFATA sets policy, Network Rail owns the infrastructure, ORR regulates, then operators run the services. The UK's biggest Create railway on the internet, aiming for the most realism possible.

> Please join our discord to become whitelisted and Speak to a member of managment, also review our website for more details on how we operate, the available roles and operators also.
